about_the_game:
Hello and Welcome!

Snapshot Aquarium is an aquarium simulator / shooter hybrid where you unlock new content by shooting pictures of fish.

Features implemented so far:

Arcade-style photo challenges

  • easy: non-frustrating, with auto-aim, focus is not needed

  • regular: with auto-aiming

  • hardcore: manual aiming, manual focus

Aquarium Editing

  • design beautiful habitats for your fish, as seen in the gameplay video

  • more than 300 items are included already, more will be added after release

Online Community Challenges

  • Visit and accomplish challenges in other player's aquariums

  • Share your own aquariums and get visitors from all over the world!

Basic Fish AI

  • Schooling, fleeing, feeding, growing in near-realtime

  • Aggressive fish chase others

Features we hope to add:

  • Realistic fish needs and happiness (certain plants, school size, ...)

  • More creative options (aquascaping)

  • Community photo quests (find the fish!)

  • Realistic fish AI and animation

  • More content

  • ... ? (Suggestions are welcome! We love working on this and don't plan to stop anytime soon)

We hope you enjoy the game already, feedback and suggestions are highly appreciated!

Love, peace and cheers,
Team Octoponx

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel Core i5-10400 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Vega 8 / Intel Iris Xe
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 9th gen, Ryzen 5 3400G
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Snapshot Aquarium is an aquarium simulator with hardcore shooting mechanics! (yes, you need this!) Build cozy habitats for your fish and unlock new content through photo safaris. Visit aquariums from players around the world – and share your own.
